Grammar point
Gerund vs Participle
Gerund People remain confused between gerund and participle because of their similarities Both are formed when ing is added to a verb There is another similarity, and that is the fact that both gerund and participle indicate some action or state of being However there are differences between them that will be highlighted in this article
Participle As indicated above) a participle can be made by adding ing to a verb  However; it becomes a participle only when adding ing to the verb makes it function as an adjective
What is the difference between Gerund and Participle?
^ gerund is a verbal noun (verb made noun by adding ing) that is derived from a verb but functions as a noun.
^ participle is a verbal that functions as an adjective
Both are made by adding ing to verbs
Verb and n0un combined is a gerund Whereas verb and adjective combined is a participle:
